name: Obsidian
description: Read, create, search, and manage notes in an Obsidian vault with frontmatter and wiki-link support
author: openmotoko

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List all markdown notes in the vault or a specific folder

folder.description: Subfolder path within the vault to list (default: vault root)

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read the full content of a note including parsed frontmatter

path.description: Path to the note relative to the vault root (e.g., 'folder/note.md')

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new note with optional YAML frontmatter

path.description: Path for the new note relative to the vault root

frontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter key-value pairs (e.g., tags, aliases)

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search notes by content or title keyword

query.description: Search query to match against note titles and content

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Update the content of an existing note

path.description: Path to the note relative to the vault root

content.description: New markdown content for the note

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description: Find all notes that link to a given note via wiki-links

path.description: Path to the note to find backlinks for
